A restrained, uneven dusting of fresh snow and frost rests on the leaf rims and seed head, with much brown leaf texture still visible. Keep the same strict 90-degree orthographic overhead viewpoint, three-leaf composition, natural photographic botanical/material detail, scale, soft daylight from upper left, and short contact shadows between objects only. Center the whole cluster with at least 10 percent fully transparent margin on ALL edges. Genuine transparent alpha including holes; no white/black matte, no chroma-key colors, no colored edge halo. This is a reusable winter game prop, NOT a complete scene.
